_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), from the research pass of 2026-10-30 (data/stations/research/fi_RI).

levels.name: Street / platform level (Asema-aukio, station building, platform 1)
Underpass (alikulkutunneli, to the island platforms and to Peltosaari)

sources.note: Laserkeilausaineisto 0,5 p, © Maanmittauslaitos, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/fi_RI).
Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0): platform heights (3D research pass; data/stations/research/vayla_platforms_FI.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM with the research pass's platform numbers, entrances, heights and amenities.

Platform heights from Digitraffic infra-api platforms (Fintraffic/Väylävirasto, CC BY 4.0); 5 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/fi_RI).
